decisions.reason: The IMU module is a low-cost core building block that fits the modular system, and with the firm growing and holding slack there is no shortfall that would prompt search for other uses of its resources.
The AC voltage input module has its own page and serves the industrial users the firm is targeting, so it likely meets aspirations and warrants continued support.
The server room kit repackages existing modules at little incremental cost, though the move to newer connectors raises some risk that the bundle is revised or retired.
The RGB LED module is new and cheap to keep in the modular line, and the firm's slack lets it carry a product whose results are still uncertain.
The wallbox remote access service supports the strategic expansion of charging and energy management, where the firm is investing, so it is kept.
